drawing.title: Drawing to parts (early prototype)
drawing.intro: Choose a picture of a drawing that shows a side view and an end view, and enter one real length. The parts are read from the lines of the picture. The numbers printed in the picture are not read: you enter them, and width and height are only used to check the scale.
drawing.lengthLabel: Overall length of the side view (mm), entered
drawing.heightLabel: Overall height of the end view (mm), only checked

endOpt.start: the start end of the side view
endOpt.end: the far end of the side view

drawing.stale: The settings changed. Press Read the drawing to update the parts.
drawing.errNoLength: Enter the overall length of the side view in mm. It sets the scale.
drawing.errExport: The IFC did not pass its structure check: {message}
drawing.dimsNote: Entered values set the scale. Checked values are compared with the picture and never change the parts.
drawing.checked: checked: about {measured} mm estimated from the picture's pixels (not a verified dimension)
drawing.overlayTitle: What was found in the picture
drawing.overlayHelp: Click a box to leave that part out. Blue are panels, orange are grilles, light blue are body blocks, grey is the pipe.
drawing.export: Download IFC of the confirmed parts
drawing.exportNote: Panels and grilles are flat plates of an assumed thickness, placed inside the overall size. Not added to the family library. Opening in Revit has not been tested.
drawing.partsSelected: Parts ({kept} of {n} selected, not confirmed yet)
drawing.selectedNote: The main parts found in the picture start selected. Possible handles, hinges, fittings and lifting eyes are guesses and start off; tick any you want. Nothing is confirmed until you press Confirm selected parts. Changing the selection removes the confirmation.
drawing.confirmedNote: You confirmed this selection. Each part keeps its tags: size estimated from the picture's pixels, entered, or assumed.
drawing.onlyDoors: Leave out panels that do not look like doors
drawing.doorLike: looks like a door (a guess from its handle and lock lines)
drawing.built: parts built: about {mm} mm (from the same estimate)
drawing.dimsWhy: The picture is measured at its widest and tallest row, which includes hinges, handles and lifting eyes. The parts use the body block, so the built size can be a few mm to a few cm smaller. Neither value is the entered one.
drawing.preview3dHelp: Drag to turn it. Blue is the body, darker blue panels, orange grilles, grey the pipe. Hidden and far-side geometry is not in the picture, so it is not shown.
drawing.sideViewLabel: Side view (the length is entered for this one)
drawing.viewsSelected: Views of the selected parts (not confirmed yet)
drawing.qualityTitle: This result does not match what you entered
drawing.qualityHelp: Treat these parts as a failed reading, not a model of the drawing. Dimension lines, text or a cluttered sheet are the usual cause.
drawing.cropHelp: Use only part of the picture (percent to cut from each side). Cut away notes, lifting diagrams and title blocks so each view stays clean. Changing it clears the result.
drawing.cropDrag: Or drag a rectangle on the picture above to choose the part to use.

calOpt.height: Use the entered height of the end view

drawing.candidate: guess from shape, not confirmed, off until you tick it
drawing.modeCrop: The part of the picture to use (crop)
drawing.vbNone: Views are found automatically. To set them yourself, draw both the side view box and the end view box.
drawing.vbOne: One view box drawn. Draw the other too; until both exist the views are found automatically.
drawing.vbBoth: Both view boxes drawn: they replace the automatic views.

familyCreator.title: Family Creator
familyCreator.intro: Choose a PDF, picture or text file, paste text, or type the overall size. Free. Files you choose, pasted text and typed sizes are read on this device and are not uploaded; pictures and scanned PDFs are read here too (OCR, English), so check the numbers it finds. A pasted link is the exception: it goes through this site's server, only if you agree each time and only where the site has switched that on. The parts come from a ready-made shape for your product, not from tracing the drawing.
familyCreator.name: Product name
familyCreator.textPlaceholder: Paste text, e.g. Overall size: 1200 x 700 x 2000 mm
familyCreator.sizeHint: Or enter the size in mm (width, depth, height). A typed size wins over pasted text.

detail.size: {w} x {d} x {h} mm (W x D x H)
detail.engineOk: {w} x {d} x {h} mm (W x D x H)
detail.noSize: No clear overall size (width x depth x height) found in the text. Enter the size yourself in the boxes above.

dest.title: Destinations
dest.revitNote: Not verified in Revit. Open the IFC in Revit 2020 and record the result.

familyCreator.sourceCheck: Check the order (width x depth x height) against the sheet.
familyCreator.glbNote: GLB is for other 3D viewers. It holds the shapes, part names and the parameter values as plain extra data. It has no IFC information, and Revit 2020 does not open it.
familyCreator.glbNoGeometry: There is no geometry to export yet.

parts.title: Parts
parts.exportTitle: What the IFC and GLB downloads contain
parts.exportAll: All parts, including any switched off here
parts.exportShown: Only the parts that are switched on
parts.scopeAll: All {n} parts are on. The IFC and GLB contain all {n} parts.
parts.scopePreviewOnly: Switched-off parts are hidden here only. The IFC and GLB still contain all {n} parts.
parts.scopeShown: The IFC and GLB leave out the switched-off parts and contain {shown} of {n} parts.
parts.countsNote: The door, drawer and shelf counts and sizes stored in the file still describe the whole family.
parts.unavailable: The parts of this shape cannot be matched to the preview, so they cannot be switched off. Nothing is hidden and the downloads contain every part.
parts.allHidden: Every part is switched off, so there is nothing to export. Switch at least one part on.

lib.reopened: Opened {name}, size "{type}". Values you change from here are marked as edited.
lib.sizeNeedsName: Give the size a name first.
lib.sizeTaken: There is already a size called "{name}".
lib.sizeCountDiffers: The number of doors, drawers or shelves differs from the saved family. Change it back, or add this as a new family instead.
lib.sizeHelp: Each size keeps its own lengths. The number of doors, drawers or shelves is part of the family, so a different count is a different family. The IFC and GLB downloads are for the size on screen.
lib.saveHelp: Updates the shape and the size you opened. Other sizes keep their own lengths.
lib.missing: That family is no longer in the library.

familyCreator.ocrCheck: Read from a picture by OCR. Digits can be misread: check each value against the sheet before you use the family.

warn.title: Not used from the sheet
warn.notUsed: {label} (page {page}, line {line}: {text}) is not a setting of the {shape} shape, so it was not used.
warn.outOfRange: {label} {value} (page {page}, line {line}: {text}) is outside what this shape allows, so the default is used instead.
warn.conflict: {label} appears with different values (page {page}, line {line} and {other}), so none was used and the default is kept. Check the sheet and enter the value yourself.
warn.ambiguous: {label} (page {page}, line {line}: {text}) could include or exclude the top and bottom shelves, so it was not used. Set Middle shelves yourself.

url.unavailable: Link import is not available on this site. Download the file and choose it above instead.
url.placeholder: Or paste a link to the sheet (https)
url.consent: I agree this link is sent to this site's server, which downloads the file for me. The site's operator can see the link. PDF, PNG, JPEG or text, up to 8 MB.

err.consent: Tick the box first. The link is only sent when you agree.
err.notAllowed: This site only fetches from a short list of approved sources, and that link is not on it.
err.refused: That link cannot be fetched. Use a public https link to a file.
err.notEnabled: Fetching from a link is not switched on for this site. Download the file and choose it instead.
err.signin: Sign in first to fetch from a link.
err.limit: Too many fetches in a minute. Wait a little and try again.
err.big: That file is larger than 8 MB.
err.type: That link is not a PDF, PNG, JPEG or text file.
err.timeout: The other site took too long to answer.
err.upstream: The other site could not be reached or refused the request.
err.generic: The link could not be fetched.
